text:
ajay: Heads-up — planning a change: tighten privnet VPC egress (deny all -> allow only NATs), and add an IAM condition on the KMS decrypt key so only requests from the privnet VPCs can decrypt. This should reduce blast radius for node leaks. Also need to reduce CloudTrail/S3 retention for audit copies to control costs. Anyone oncall for EU tonight?

lina: want the exact rollout plan before we touch prod. can we do a canary in staging -> eu-west -> prod? timeline? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: quick Q — will this break GPU node bootstrapping? our bootstrap uses KMS to unwrap instance secrets at startup. If we lock to VPC condition, IMDS/SSM path must still work. we should test with a warm pool node.

ajay: good call. plan is: (1) add IAM condition on the key policy referencing aws:SourceVpc and aws:SourceIp for privnet subnets, (2) create a temporary grant for node bootstrap role, expire in 48h, (3) canary in staging, then eu-low-traffic, then global. will run a warm-pool test first.

marie: storage/cost note — current CloudTrail S3 retention is 365d with GLACIER for old objects. if we shift to 90d it saves ~25% on storage, but we need to keep logs for compliance for 6 months in some customers. propose lifecycle: 90d standard -> 180d glacier -> 365d deep archive for regulated accounts only.

quan: sample IAM condition snippet for key policy (dev only):
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowDecryptFromPrivnet",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/node-bootstrap"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abcd1234"}
  }
}
```

quan: also recommend adding a KMS grant for the bootstrap flow instead of long-lived policy changes, then revoke the grant after verification. grants are easier to audit and rollback.

devon: for warm-pool test, run this against a staging GPU node: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/health | jq .` and verify key unwrap logs: `grep -i unwrap /var/log/instance-init.log`

srebot: scheduled_maintenance: Deploy window approved 02:00-04:00 UTC. notif sent to oncall.

lina: ok — canary schedule looks good. who will own the PR and run the warm-pool smoke? i can take ownership of the canary run in eu-staging.

ajay: i'll open a PR with the policy diff and lifecycle rule. @lina please run the warm-pool test and paste results here. @devon please prepare rollback steps (revoke grant + revert policy). i'll coordinate with security for audit tickets.

marie: will update cost projection and file a variance note. also opening a compliance exception form for regulated customers so we don't auto-trim their logs.

ajay: thanks team. action items: ajay -> PR + coord, lina -> warm-pool canary, devon -> rollback playbook, quan -> liverun test for grants, marie -> cost + compliance. aim to start canary at 02:10 UTC.

lina: got it. will post results within the window. :white_check_mark:

ajay: final note — add alert in Console: if KMS decrypt error rate > 0.5% for node-bootstrap service for 10m, auto rollback to previous policy + send page.

devon: will add the PagerDuty rule and a runbook snippet in the PR.

srebot: note: oncall ack received from team: lina, devon.
